verdict.rationale: Salv documents user-defined rules that fire automatically on events. Clearance rules auto-close alerts meeting conditions you set, and monitoring scenarios with custom type, threshold and segments raise alerts on transactions. Both can be backtested before going live. The documented actions are limited to raising or closing alerts, and webhooks only notify external systems; there is no general event→action rule engine. Missing for 10: configurable action types beyond alert raise/close, documentation of the rule-builder trigger/action model, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Clearance rules close alerts that meet conditions you set, from the library or your own, and every auto-closed alert stays on the record as an audit trail.
Start from the library and adjust each scenario's type, threshold and segments, or add your own alongside them.
Set an alert suppression interval so a repeating customer doesn't re-alert every day.
Draft a flow, run it against your own history with different settings, and see the alerts it would have raised before it goes live.
